demos.name: Hybrid FHIR Operational Data Layer
demos.tagline: Unify clinical data with FHIR-native MongoDB architecture
demos.description: A reference architecture that develops a FHIR hybrid ODL pattern for healthcare. Creates a single, highly performant operational store powering web services while exposing FHIR-compatible endpoints.
demos.longDescription: This solution demonstrates how to build a FHIR-centric data model in MongoDB that serves both custom application endpoints and standards-based FHIR APIs. The three-block document structure (canonical FHIR, application metadata, and search optimization) enables maximum flexibility without data duplication.
